inspector_lens: 6-year audit trail, NF525 art. 88 — every fiscal-adjacent state transition must be traceable, immutable, integrity-signed, and reconstitutable years after the fact. KDS bumps are the link between sale (POS/Kiosk) and fulfillment (chef) — if an inspector asks 'show me, for order #4521 of 2026-04-12, who marked it PREPARED, when, from what station, and prove nothing in the chain has been altered', the system must answer.

gaps.title: KDS status transitions NOT chained in NF525 audit_logs (HMAC) — only best-effort row in order_status_transitions

evidence.cross_ref: OrderStateMachine.php:132-159 — recordTransition() writes ONLY to order_status_transitions table (id, order_id, from_status, to_status, actor_id, occurred_at). NO HMAC, NO prev_hash, NO current_hash. NO call to AuditLogService::append().

gaps.inspector_question: Prove order #X moved ACCEPT→PREPARING→PREPARED on 2026-04-12 at 14:23, and prove that row has not been silently UPDATEd or DELETEd between today and your retention horizon (6 years).
gaps.current_answer: Impossible. order_status_transitions has no HMAC chain, no BEFORE DELETE trigger, no GRANT-level DELETE revocation (unlike audit_logs + z_reports per CLAUDE.md §8). Any DBA with write access can silently UPDATE from_status/to_status or DELETE rows; integrity cannot be proven.
gaps.impact: NF525 art. 88 III — 'inaltérabilité' compromised for the fulfillment leg of the order lifecycle. Inspector cannot validate kitchen throughput timelines, contested bumps, or staff-action timelines beyond the trust placed in raw MySQL rows. Risk: chain claim 'NF525 chain bit-identical' (BRAIN §8) covers ONLY orders/payments, NOT KDS state — gap not declared to owner.
gaps.remediation_sketch: Either (a) call AuditLogService::append() inside DB::transaction at line 297 with payload {order_id, from, to, actor_id, branch_id, source: 'kds'}, OR (b) add a BEFORE DELETE/UPDATE trigger + GRANT REVOKE on order_status_transitions matching the audit_logs hardening pattern (CLAUDE.md §8). Option (a) is preferred — it ties KDS into the SAME chain as fiscal events, so an inspector hash-walks ONE chain end-to-end.

gaps.title: KdsHistoryDrawer reads `updated_at` as proxy for 'bumped at' — non-NF525-compliant timestamp (mutable, ambiguous, race-prone)

evidence.cross_ref: KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService.php:185-217 — comment explicitly says 'closest proxy to bump time without adding a new bumped_at column'. KDSOrderDetailsResource.php:37 — 'updated_at' => $this->updated_at?->toIso8601String() exposed identically.

gaps.inspector_question: What was the EXACT moment chef bumped order #X to PREPARED on 2026-04-12 — and prove no later mutation (eg. address edit, status revert backlog, payment_pending_counter flip) shifted this displayed time.
gaps.current_answer: updated_at is touched by EVERY Eloquent save() on the order row (composition_snapshot freeze, address eager-load mutation, payment status flip, fiscal_alloc_error_at retry, ...). Service comment admits 'closest proxy without adding bumped_at column'. After 1 hour, even a single subsequent save() invalidates the displayed time for forensic purposes.
gaps.impact: Inspector reconciliation against order_status_transitions.occurred_at and audit_logs (when chained) will diverge. Customer-litigation case (customer claims 'I received cold food at 14:50' vs chef claims 'bumped at 14:23') becomes un-resolvable from the historique drawer alone — the displayed 14:23 may have shifted to 14:35 after a downstream save.
gaps.remediation_sketch: Add `kds_bumped_at` (or use order_status_transitions.occurred_at filtered to to_status=PREPARED) as the authoritative timestamp in KDSOrderDetailsResource. Drawer should bind `order.kds_prepared_at` (server-derived, immutable post-write), not `order.updated_at`.

gaps.title: Actor identity is RECORDED in transitions but NEVER EXPOSED in KDS history drawer — inspector cannot answer 'who bumped'

evidence.code: Resource exposes id, order_serial_no, status, queue_number, items, customer (name + delivery-phone only), order_address. NO actor_id, NO chef name, NO station_id, NO terminal_id.
evidence.cross_ref: KdsHistoryDrawer.vue:101-117 — `<header>` shows N°/status/time only. No 'Préparé par X' cell.

gaps.inspector_question: Identify the staff member responsible for the PREPARED transition of order #X — name, employee number, station, and login session.
gaps.current_answer: actor_id is captured into order_status_transitions (OrderStateMachine.php:150) but the historyToday() service does NOT eager-load this relation, the Resource does NOT expose it, and the drawer Vue template does NOT render it. From the historique drawer, the inspector sees an anonymous bump.
gaps.impact: Accountability gap — a contested transition (customer says food was bumped before being plated) cannot be traced to a specific chef. Combined with G01 (no HMAC chain), even the back-end forensic answer is weak: we have an actor_id but no integrity guarantee it wasn't UPDATEd post-hoc.
gaps.remediation_sketch: Eager-load latest transition to PREPARED in historyToday(): `$query->with(['latestStatusTransition' => fn($q) => $q->where('to_status', PREPARED)->with('actor')])`. Add `bumped_by` to KDSOrderDetailsResource. Render in drawer as 'Préparé par: {{ order.bumped_by_name }}' with WCAG-compliant label.

gaps.title: ZReport (daily clôture) does NOT include kitchen throughput KPIs — kitchen-side hole in fiscal day-end snapshot

evidence.lines: grep result: NO 'kds' nor 'kitchen' references in ZReportService.php
evidence.code: Z report aggregates orders by payment + fiscal sequence — there is no kds_bumped_count, no avg_prep_time, no station_throughput for the day.
evidence.cross_ref: ZReportService is on the NF525 frozen list (CLAUDE.md §7); however, ADDING fields is forward-compatible if the chain hash recomputes deterministically.

gaps.inspector_question: For fiscal day 2026-04-12 in branch #3, how many orders were marked PREPARED, how many were marked OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, how many were marked DELIVERED — and reconcile against payment-closed count.
gaps.current_answer: Z report shows the payment/order side ONLY. A divergence (eg. 142 orders paid in POS but only 138 marked PREPARED in KDS — 4 orders never reached the kitchen / chef forgot to bump) is INVISIBLE in the Z. The inspector must cross-query order_status_transitions manually, which (per G01) has no integrity guarantee.
gaps.impact: Daily NF525 snapshot is incomplete for operational reconciliation. Audit defenders cannot 'one-stop' prove kitchen-completion alignment with sales — they must hand over two artefacts (Z + raw transition table) and explain why one is chained and the other is not.
gaps.remediation_sketch: Add aggregated kitchen KPIs to ZReportService payload (kds_prepared_count, kds_avg_lead_seconds, kds_out_count, kds_delivered_count) — derived from order_status_transitions filtered to day-bounds before chain-signing. NO mutation of existing fields, only additive — chain compat preserved if append order remains stable.

gaps.title: DELETED orders (cancellation post-bump) leave NO trace in KdsHistoryDrawer — inspector cannot prove revert-cancellation chain

evidence.code: historyToday() filters whereIn('status', [PREPARED, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED]) and whereBetween('updated_at', [todayStart, tomorrowStart]). If an order is CANCELED after being PREPARED (eg. customer no-show after bump), it disappears from the drawer.
evidence.cross_ref: KdsHistoryDrawer.vue:139-142 — comment says 'revert PREPARED → PREPARING is intentionally NOT exposed here' (V1.0.2 backlog), but the issue extends to FORWARD-to-CANCELED post-bump, which IS allowed by OrderStateMachine.

gaps.inspector_question: Customer disputes a 2026-04-12 charge — claims they never received order #X even though it was bumped PREPARED. Show me the bumped-then-canceled trail in the KDS historique.
gaps.current_answer: The order is filtered out because its current status is CANCELED, not PREPARED/OUT/DELIVERED. The chef has NO visibility from the drawer that the order WAS prepared then later cancelled. The full trail lives only in order_status_transitions (which is unsigned per G01).
gaps.impact: Customer-dispute resolution from chef's view becomes impossible. Forces the dispute path through admin-only screens, defeating the owner mandate cited in the controller docblock: 'chef sees all PREPARED/OUT/DELIVERED orders today to verify content if a customer reports an error'.
gaps.remediation_sketch: Extend historyToday() to include orders whose order_status_transitions table shows ANY transition to PREPARED today (regardless of current status). Display canceled-after-bump orders with a `is-canceled` border-left state in the drawer (mirror existing is-prepared/is-out/is-delivered pattern at KdsHistoryDrawer.vue:386-388).

gaps.title: No correlation_id surfaced in KDS history — multi-channel order tracing broken for audit reconstruction

evidence.cross_ref: KDSOrderDetailsResource.php:21-77 — correlation_id NOT exposed. KdsHistoryDrawer.vue — NOT rendered.

gaps.inspector_question: For order #X, reconstruct the full causal chain — POS submission → fiscal_seq allocation → KDS bump → ticket dispatch → customer notification — and prove these events are linked.
gaps.current_answer: OrderStateMachine captures correlation_id PER TRANSITION (line 153) but it's never surfaced to KDS UI or KDS Resource. Audit reconstruction must JOIN order_status_transitions ↔ audit_logs ↔ webhook_events manually by correlation_id, only possible via DB direct access.
gaps.impact: Slows audit response; in adversarial NF525 inspection, every minute of delay = penalty risk. Also a missed opportunity to surface correlation_id in the historique drawer for chef-side dispute resolution.
gaps.remediation_sketch: Add `latest_transition_correlation_id` to KDSOrderDetailsResource (read from order_status_transitions for the most recent transition). Render as a small hidden-by-default 'tech details' affordance in the drawer item — invisible by default to chef, opens via keyboard shortcut for admin/inspector.

gaps.title: Drawer limit hard-coded to 50 — inspector view truncates without warning

evidence.cross_ref: KdsHistoryDrawer.vue:43 — '({{ orders.length }})' just shows count, no overflow indicator. Compare to index() at controller:30-34 which DOES expose meta.overflow.

gaps.inspector_question: On a busy Saturday with 200 orders, prove the historique drawer shows ALL PREPARED today.
gaps.current_answer: It doesn't — capped at 50, no UI signal that older PREPARED orders exist. Inspector or chef gets a silently-truncated view.
gaps.impact: Same class of issue Wave T already fixed for index() (meta.overflow). Inconsistent gate handling between two sibling endpoints.
gaps.remediation_sketch: Mirror the index() additional() meta pattern (`KitchenDisplaySystemController:30-34`): expose meta.overflow + meta.limit on the historyToday endpoint, render banner in drawer when overflow=true.

gaps.title: No source_surface in drawer item — inspector cannot distinguish Borne/POS/Mobile origins post-bump

evidence.code: Header renders N° + status + time. NO source surface badge.
evidence.cross_ref: KDSOrderDetailsResource.php:29 — source_surface IS in the payload ('kiosk' | 'pos' | 'web' | 'mobile' | 'admin'). Drawer just doesn't render it.

gaps.inspector_question: Of yesterday's 142 PREPARED orders, how many originated from the kiosk vs POS vs delivery app?
gaps.current_answer: Drawer hides the source. The data IS in the payload (per the Wave T E-003 round-3 fix at Resource line 29), but the UI does not surface it.
gaps.impact: Forces admin to cross-tab to OSS or admin/orders for a question already answerable from the drawer dataset. Minor — UX gap, not integrity gap.
gaps.remediation_sketch: Add a small badge next to the queue number in KdsHistoryDrawer.vue:101-117: 'Borne' / 'Caisse' / 'Web' / 'Mobile' / 'Admin' from order.source_surface, with WCAG-AA color contrast.

summary.headline: KDS state transitions sit OUTSIDE the NF525 HMAC chain (audit_logs + z_reports) — they're persisted to a best-effort, unsigned, deletable order_status_transitions table. Combined with the drawer's use of mutable `updated_at` as a 'bumped at' proxy and the absence of actor/correlation surfacing, an NF525 inspector cannot independently prove kitchen-throughput integrity over the 6-year retention horizon.
top_3_for_caller: S3-P5-G01: KDS transitions NOT in NF525 HMAC chain — order_status_transitions is unsigned, deletable, unprotected by DB trigger/GRANT-revoke unlike audit_logs/z_reports (CLAUDE.md §8).

S3-P5-G02: KdsHistoryDrawer uses mutable `updated_at` as 'bumped at' time — service code explicitly admits it's a proxy 'without adding a bumped_at column'; any subsequent save() invalidates forensic reconstruction.
S3-P5-G03: Actor identity captured in transitions table but never exposed in KDSOrderDetailsResource nor rendered in drawer — chef-bump is anonymous in the historique view.
